posts.author: bgillisp
posts.body: Depends. If you just need sprites that is usually $15 - $20 per sprite. If you want busts then it can be another $40 - $200+ each depending on quality. Facesets are often charged depending on how many emotions you want so that varies too much to post.

posts.author: Bazinioli
posts.body:
Price would also likely depend on what style you're looking for and how familiar the artist is with working in that style. JRPG-style is sort of really vague so it's hard to make a good estimate. Keep in mind that EarthBound, Octopath Travellers, Chrono Trigger and Final Fantasy 1 on NES are all "JRPG styles" and all look wildly different from each other.
If you're looking for a style that matches closely with XP's RTP style, for example, that may cost more than smaller chibi size/one tile tall sprites. Meanwhile retro styles that mimic things like NES games often are a bit cheaper since they're easier to make fast.
